definition: Assesses natural-hazard risk at identified facilities, assets or candidate sites.
Assesses natural-hazard risk along an infrastructure alignment or corridor.
Assesses natural-hazard risk across an interconnected network or system, including dependencies.
Assesses natural-hazard risk across a sector, national infrastructure stock or investment portfolio.
Produces or updates hazard, exposure or vulnerability maps. Consulting existing maps alone is insufficient.
Investigates or models natural hazards to inform investment, design or operations.
Assesses how natural hazards could interrupt services or institutional functions. Excludes generic continuity planning.
